# streamer-toolbox

> One program for live streamers that glues their tools together: buttons, flows (boxes connected by wires,
> started by triggers such as a channel point redeem, a follow, a key or a timer), alerts and widgets on stream.
> It runs on the streamer's own PC (Python, NiceGUI + FastAPI), talks to OBS, VTube Studio, SAMMI, Mix It Up,
> Twitch and other services, and has an HTTP API so other programs and AI agents can run its actions.

This file is the starting point for AI agents. It holds no content of its own: find your situation in the
table and read only the files in that row. Where a doc and the code disagree, the code is right.

## Always read

- [docs/ai/rules.md](docs/ai/rules.md): what must never be done to a streamer's PC or live stream (short)

## Find your situation

Part 1: using the toolbox from outside (you don't change its code)

| Your situation | Read |
|---|---|
| I have to start the toolbox, or find out whether it is running | [docs/ai/use/start.md](docs/ai/use/start.md) |
| I want to run something in the toolbox from my own program (press a button, run a flow, switch a scene) | [docs/ai/use/api.md](docs/ai/use/api.md) |
| My call is refused or fails (401, 403, 404, 422, 500) | [docs/ai/use/api.md](docs/ai/use/api.md), then [docs/ai/use/access.md](docs/ai/use/access.md) |
| I need a token, more permissions, or access from another PC | [docs/ai/use/access.md](docs/ai/use/access.md) |
| I don't know which action does what I want | [docs/ai/use/actions.md](docs/ai/use/actions.md) |
| I want to start the streamer's flows, or tell the toolbox that something happened (a tip, an event of mine) | [docs/ai/use/actions.md](docs/ai/use/actions.md) |
| I want to be told when something happens on stream (a follow, a redeem, a chat message) | [docs/ai/use/events.md](docs/ai/use/events.md) |
| A person asks me how to use the toolbox's pages (connections, flows, alerts, widgets) | docs/USER_GUIDE.md (in the packed archive: README.md), docs/WIDGETS.md |

Part 2: writing a plugin (your own folder in `plugins/`, the toolbox's code stays untouched)

| Your situation | Read |
|---|---|
| I want to add my own action, tool tab, page or API route without touching the toolbox's code | [docs/PLUGINS.md](docs/PLUGINS.md) |
| My plugin doesn't load, or I want to test it before the streamer uses it | [docs/ai/plugin/check.md](docs/ai/plugin/check.md) |
| I'm not sure whether my idea is a plugin or a change to the toolbox itself | [docs/ai/plugin/check.md](docs/ai/plugin/check.md) |

Part 3: changing the toolbox's own code (the repository)

| Your situation | Read |
|---|---|
| I am about to edit anything under `src/` or `tests/` | [docs/ai/code/rules.md](docs/ai/code/rules.md) |
| I want the toolbox to talk to a new program or service | [docs/ai/code/connection.md](docs/ai/code/connection.md) |
| I want a new box / action in the toolbox itself | [docs/ai/code/action.md](docs/ai/code/action.md) |
| I want something new to be able to start flows (a new event or trigger) | [docs/ai/code/events.md](docs/ai/code/events.md) |
| I need to find where something is in the code, or how flows, wires and the editor work inside | docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (repository only; long, read the section you need) |
| I am adding or changing one of these AI docs | [docs/ai/MAINTAIN.md](docs/ai/MAINTAIN.md) |
